01shop/ʃɒp/ ✓ 已标记
v. 购物；n. 商店
I usually shop at the supermarket near my home.
shop 作动词是“购物”：go shopping（去购物）；shop online（网上购物）。
02shopping/ˈʃɒpɪŋ/ ✓ 已标记
n. 购物
We went shopping for new clothes yesterday.
搭配：go shopping（去购物）；a shopping list（购物清单）。
03store/stɔː/ ✓ 已标记
n. 商店
This store sells clothes at low prices.
搭配：a clothes store（服装店）；in a store（在商店里）。
04market/ˈmɑːkɪt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 市场；集市
My mother buys vegetables at the market every morning.
搭配：a fruit market（水果市场）；go to the market（去市场）。
05supermarket/ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 超市
There is a big supermarket across from our school.
搭配：at the supermarket（在超市里）；a supermarket（超级市场）。
06price/praɪs/ ✓ 已标记
n. 价格
The price of this coat is too high for me.
搭配：a low price（低价）；at a good price（以优惠的价格）。
07cost/kɒst/ ✓ 已标记
n. 成本；价格；v. 花费
How much does this bike cost?
cost 的过去式是 cost；cost a lot of money（花费很多钱）。
08cheap/tʃiːp/ ✓ 已标记
adj. 便宜的
These shoes are cheap, but they look nice.
cheap 的反义词是 expensive（昂贵的）；a cheap price（便宜的价格）。
09expensive/ɪkˈspensɪv/ ✓ 已标记
adj. 昂贵的
This watch is too expensive for a student.
expensive 的反义词是 cheap（便宜的）；an expensive gift（贵重的礼物）。
10discount/ˈdɪskaʊnt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 折扣
The shop gives a 20% discount on all books today.
搭配：at a discount（打折）；a big discount（大幅折扣）。
11sale/seɪl/ ✓ 已标记
n. 销售；大减价
There is a big sale in the shopping centre this weekend.
搭配：on sale（减价出售）；a sale（大减价）。
12bargain/ˈbɑːɡɪn/ ✓ 已标记
n. 便宜货；v. 讨价还价
I got this bag at a bargain price.
bargain 还有“讨价还价”的意思：bargain with sb（和某人讨价还价）。
13buy/baɪ/ ✓ 已标记
v. 买
I want to buy a new bag for my mother.
buy 的过去式是 bought；buy sth for sb（为某人买某物）。
14sell/sel/ ✓ 已标记
v. 卖
This shop sells fresh fruit every day.
sell 的过去式是 sold；sell sth to sb（把某物卖给某人）。
15pay/peɪ/ ✓ 已标记
v. 付钱
You can pay by cash or by card.
搭配：pay for sth（为某物付款）；pay in cash（用现金支付）。
16cash/kæʃ/ ✓ 已标记
n. 现金
I have no cash with me today.
搭配：in cash（用现金）；pay in cash（用现金支付）。
17credit/ˈkredɪt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 信用；赊账
You can buy this phone on credit.
搭配：on credit（赊购）；a credit card（信用卡）。
18bill/bɪl/ ✓ 已标记
n. 账单
Please bring me the bill.
搭配：pay the bill（付账）；a phone bill（电话账单）。
19receipt/rɪˈsiːt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 收据
Please keep the receipt if you want to return it.
搭配：a receipt（收据）；ask for a receipt（索要收据）。
20wallet/ˈwɒlɪt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 钱包
I left my wallet at home this morning.
搭配：a wallet（钱包）；in one's wallet（在钱包里）。
21product/ˈprɒdʌkt/ ✓ 已标记
n. 产品
This shop sells many new products.
搭配：a new product（新产品）；the price of a product（产品的价格）。
22brand/brænd/ ✓ 已标记
n. 品牌
Many young people like this brand of shoes.
搭配：a famous brand（著名品牌）；a new brand（新品牌）。
23customer/ˈkʌstəmə/ ✓ 已标记
n. 顾客
The shop serves many customers every day.
搭配：a customer（顾客）；serve customers（为顾客服务）。
24service/ˈsɜːvɪs/ ✓ 已标记
n. 服务
The service in this restaurant is very good.
搭配：good service（优质服务）；a service（一种服务）。
25order/ˈɔːdə/ ✓ 已标记
v. 订购；n. 订单
I ordered a book online yesterday.
order 作名词是“订单”：place an order（下订单）；an order（订单）。
26deliver/dɪˈlɪvə/ ✓ 已标记
v. 递送；交付
The shop will deliver the desk to your home tomorrow.
搭配：deliver sth to sb（把某物送给某人）；deliver goods（送货）。
27return/rɪˈtɜːn/ ✓ 已标记
v. 归还；退货
You can return the shirt if it does not fit.
return 还有“回来”的意思：return home（回家）；return sth（退货）。
28refund/ˈriːfʌnd/ ✓ 已标记
v./n. 退款
The shop gave me a full refund for the broken radio.
搭配：a refund（退款）；ask for a refund（要求退款）。
29afford/əˈfɔːd/ ✓ 已标记
v. 负担得起
I cannot afford such an expensive car.
搭配：afford sth（买得起某物）；can afford to do sth（负担得起做某事）。
30spend/spend/ ✓ 已标记
v. 花费（钱/时间）
She spends too much money on clothes every month.
spend 的过去式是 spent；spend money on sth（在某物上花钱）。
